svg.title: dots.tts NFE timing profile
svg.desc: Single-prompt dots.tts NFE timing charts. Individual points show measured repeats, the blue line shows the median, and whiskers show the interquartile range. Warmups are excluded. Timing results do not establish prompt adherence or speech quality.
svg.text: One target prompt (short): The small red bird landed on the garden fence.
45 measured generations across 9 fixed NFE settings, 5 repeats per setting; warmups excluded
Median latency: 6.96s at NFE 4 to 36.09s at NFE 32 (5.19x). Only NFE 4 was below real time by median RTF.
TIMING ONLY. The prior run was reported to repeat the reference phrase. Prompt adherence remains unverified.
Wall-clock latency per measured generation. Dots show all repeats; line shows the median.
RTF = generation latency / generated audio duration. Below 1.0 means faster than playback.
Zoomed axis for detail. Observed duration: 8.16 to 9.12 seconds; axis starts at 7.5 seconds.
Dots: individual repeats. Blue line: median. Whiskers: interquartile range. Warmups are excluded.
